messages.content: What is the meaning of the word indolent I ND OL ENT

message.content:
**Indolent** means **lazy**, **idle**, or **not wanting to work or be active**.[1][4][5]

It can also mean **slow to develop or heal** in medicine, such as an **indolent tumor** or **indolent ulcer**.[1][4][6]

A simple example: *“He was indolent and spent the morning in bed.”*[1][3]
